artworks.title: Chenes de Roche (Rock Oaks)
artworks.artist: Théodore Rousseau
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense woodland with a ground-level perspective. The horizon is obscured by foliage and tree trunks. The etching style is precise and features intricate lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic. The scene includes large trees, rocks, and a dense canopy overhead, all detailed in the etching.

artworks.title: La Guerre (The War)
artworks.artist: Henri Rousseau (artist); Alfred Jarry and Rémy de Gourmont (publishers)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a central figure on horseback. The image shows a figure riding a rearing horse across a tumultuous landscape. The figure holds an object raised on its left. The environment is chaotic, with abstract forms and human figures in various positions below. The background features swirling lines that enhance the sense of motion and energy. The color scheme is monochromatic, with bold lines against an orange backdrop, adding a dramatic effect to the composition.

artworks.title: Corner of a Drawing Room
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with classical elements such as columns and intricate moldings. The drawing depicts a section of an interior space with tall columns supporting a decorated ceiling. The upper part of the drawing shows detailed moldings and decorative panels. There is a statue placed between the columns. The drawing uses pencil to highlight details and shading, creating depth and elegance.

artworks.title: Laban Searching for his Household Gods (Laban chercant des dieux)
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is an intricate drawing of a group scene set in a pastoral environment. The composition shows several figures engaged in various activities. The figures are dressed in elaborate robes and striking poses. The central focus is on two standing figures, surrounded by others who are seated or kneeling. In the background, there are clouds in the sky and faint outlines of trees, suggesting an outdoor setting. The use of line work and shading creates texture and depth in this detailed etching.

artworks.title: Merope
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene set in an ornate architectural environment. The composition displays an elaborately detailed scene inside a grand hall featuring classical architectural elements such as columns and an intricately decorated domed ceiling. The space is populated by figures engaged in an intense scene that appears to involve dramatic action or dialogue, as indicated by their expressive gestures. The surroundings are sumptuously decorated, creating a rich, textured background that enhances the sense of drama. The style of the drawing, with fine lines and shaded details, suggests a meticulous and illustrative approach typical of the 18th century, reflecting the artistic skill in creating depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: La mort de Germanicus
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a luxuriously decorated room with classical sculptures and intricate drapery. The image features detailed drapery hanging on both sides and over an arching structure. In the room, there are two partially draped statues and various decorative motifs and designs. The space includes columns and architectural elements that add depth. At the rear, there is a framed scene, possibly depicting a chariot scene, surrounded by intricate carvings. The artwork shows detailed line work and textures characteristic of classical or baroque styles.

artworks.title: The Death of Tancred
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with classical architecture. The scene features a large hall with grand columns and a high, arched ceiling. In the center, there is a group of figures engaged in an interaction. The architectural details, including columns and archways, show intricate line work and perspective. The scene conveys a sense of historical or mythical significance, with figures in elaborate attire and dramatic poses. The drawing emphasizes classical style and form with detailed linework.

artworks.title: Triomphe de Pompee dans Rome
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image shows a busy scene from a high vantage point. The view captures a detailed panorama of a city with classical buildings and columns lining the horizon. The scene includes various architectural elements, figures, an elaborate procession with elephants and horses, and a bustling crowd. The artwork features intricate brushwork, possibly a drawing or etching technique. The color palette is monochrome with shades of sepia or grey, emphasizing the detailed linework.

artworks.title: Title Page: Oval Design from the Church of San Michele de Bosco, Bologna
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Carlo Cignani
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative cartouche framed by two cherubs. The drawing features a large oval cartouche at the center, inscribed with elegant cursive script. Two cherubs flank the cartouche on either side, each pulling back draped fabric as if unveiling the inscription. The cherubs are drawn with classical anatomical proportions and portrayed in a soft, sketch-like style with subtle shading. The monochrome palette enhances the sense of an aged illustration.

artworks.title: Dr. Koller
artworks.artist: Egon Schiele
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's upper torso, head, and hands. The man faces slightly left with eyes closed or looking downward. He has a prominent nose, a small mustache, and wavy short hair. His hands are shown, with one hand extended and the other resting on a surface. The man wears a collared shirt with a bow tie. The drawing style is minimalist with contour lines, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Title Page for Nova Reperta (New Discoveries)
artworks.artist: Attributed to Hans Collaert the Younger after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This image depicts an assortment of objects and symbols representing discoveries and inventions. It includes items such as a map, celestial instruments, printing press, alchemical apparatus, and globes. Two large circular medallions are featured in the center of the composition. One has a map labeled with "Christopher Columbus," and the other features a star with the name "Flavius Amalfitanus Inventor." Various tools and objects surrounding these central elements suggest a theme of discovery, innovation, and exploration. The artwork's classical style pays homage to scientific and exploratory achievements.

artworks.title: America
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and hatching, a man wearing a cloak and holding an astrolabe and a banner stands in front of a nearly nude woman reclining on a hammock in this horizontal engraving. To our left, the clean-shaven man has a bumped nose and soft jowls. He wears a brimless, high-crowned, floppy hat and a cloak over a tunic and stockings. The banner is long and decorated with a cross, and the staff holding it is topped with a cross. The man holds the astrolabe, a circular navigational instrument about the size of a dessert plate, that hangs from a ring with the other hand. The woman has a short, round nose, full cheeks, and her lips are parted. Long hair falls loosely to her waist under a cap-like headdress, perhaps made of feathers. A ring of feathers is around her hips, and a metal band, presumably gold, encircles one shin. On the hammock, she sits up and holds one hand up toward the man. The hammock hangs from two trees near a rocky coastline, which lies to our left. A masted ship with billowing sails is along the left edge of the sheet, and a rowboat is pulled up to the coastline. Animals, including what might be a tapir and perhaps a monkey or tiny bear in one tree, stand or walk through the landscape. In the background, a nude woman sits with a child near another woman and a nude man who roast a person’s leg, cut off from the waist, on a spit over a fire. Another skewer with another leg lies nearby. Inscriptions under the man in the print read, “Ioan. Stradanus inuent. Theodor Galle Sculp.” Text printed under the image reads, “AMERICA. Americen Americus retexit, &  Semel vocauit inde semper exitam.” The print is numbered 1 under the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Lapis Polaris, Magnes (The Lodestone, The Magnet)
artworks.artist: Attributed to Hans Collaert the Younger after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: A large wooden ship is suspended from the ceiling in a room. In the foreground, there is a round table holding a circular object. Near the ship, an open book rests on another table with texts and geometric instruments. Additionally, a globe and an armillary sphere are present. A man is seated at a desk, reading the book with a tool in his hand. Behind him is a bed with curtains and a sleeping dog. On the left wall, there is a large painting above a closed wooden cabinet.

artworks.title: Pulvis Pyrius (Gunpowder)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cannon foundry or workshop. The image shows various figures engaged in the process of manufacturing cannons. One person is working with a large bellows system, while others handle cannon parts or prepare molds. A large wheel suggests machinery in motion. The architecture includes stone arches and the setting includes cannonballs and ropes. In the background, a landscape is visible, showing figures and cannons in action amid smoke and fortifications.

artworks.title: Impressio Liborum (Printing Books)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet

artworks.title: Horologia Ferrea (Iron Clocks)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a clockmaker's workshop. It depicts several individuals engaged in various tasks related to clockmaking. One person is crafting clock parts at a workbench, while another is examining a completed timepiece. The workshop is filled with tools, gears, and horological instruments, with detailed etchings. In the background, an open furnace is visible, with an assistant tending to its flames. Shelves display completed clocks or parts. The scene captures the complexity and precision of historical clockmaking, with structured architecture adding depth and historical context.

artworks.title: Hyacum, et Lues Venerea (Guaiacum and Venereal Infection)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior scene featuring multiple rooms and activities. One room depicts a person in bed with another holding a candle. The room is detailed with pillows, a bed frame, and an object on the wall. The other room shows people cooking and preparing food, with kitchenware on shelves and tables. Details include a candlelit table, a person chopping wood, and various utensils.

artworks.title: Distillatio (Distillation)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This print shows an alchemical laboratory filled with various apparatuses and equipment associated with distillation, such as flasks, large tubs or vessels, and tubes and wires. There are adult men and young boys engaged in tasks throughout the scene, stoking fires, holding vessels, reading books, or conversing with one another. The setting is a large room with high ceilings, arches and beams. Shelves line the walls, full of more equipment, and more men are seen working in the background, surrounded by smoke and vapors.

artworks.title: Ser, Sive Sericus Vermis (Silk, or the Silkworm)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: The image shows a regal gathering with individuals wearing elaborate robes and headpieces. The foreground features a group gathered around a seated figure, and the scene includes an outdoor area where silkworm cultivation is taking place. The seated figure is on an ornately carved chair, and there are figures engaged in silk production processes in the background. The scene is detailed, with a focus on clothing and expressions.

artworks.title: Staphae, Sive Stapedes (Stirrups, or Foot Rests)
artworks.artist: Workshop of Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This image portrays a historical street scene. It shows a busy environment with horses and people engaged in various activities. There are individuals preparing horses, one horse being ridden, and a person crafting or repairing an object, possibly a saddle. In the background, there is a storefront with goods displayed and people working inside. The architecture features stone buildings with arched doorways and a distant dome, indicating a European town setting. The scene conveys daily life focusing on equestrian and craft activities.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Antonio Tempesta
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. In the center are three crucified figures, with the central figure slightly more emphasized and wearing a halo. Surrounding them are mourners, including several women in deep sorrow. Soldiers and onlookers are also present, some on horseback, against a backdrop of a mountainous landscape and a distant city. The scene is framed by expressive clouds, and the drawing's tones convey depth and emotion. The artist's style suggests skill in etching or engraving techniques, capturing the somber event with religious undertones.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered around a table. They are sitting, with one person positioned at the right end of the table, dressed in a robe with long sleeves. This person has medium-length wavy hair. The others around the table have varied hair lengths and beard styles. They are wearing long robes and historical garments. In the foreground, there is a dog sitting attentively. The setting includes large stone columns, an archway in the background, a stairway leading upwards, and a person carrying a vessel on their head. Parts of a building are visible beyond the arch.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Two Saints
artworks.artist: Antonio da Trento, after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks
artworks.description: This is a painting portraying multiple muscular figures, some in robes and others armed or in dynamic poses. The central figure is shown in an aggressive stance, holding a weapon with other figures around them engaged in the scene. The setting includes architectural elements like steps, columns, and an opulent backdrop. The color palette consists of warm tones and intricate line work, reminiscent of Baroque artists like Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.artist: Sebastiano de Valentinis
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a scene from a slightly elevated point of view. In the foreground on the right, a woman sits with a baby in her lap next to a tree and rock, while a man reclines below. In the distance, a village with buildings and a path is visible in a rocky landscape, with small figures present. The background features hills and cliffs, with a figure in the sky holding a banner. The etching is detailed, with precise line work and cross-hatching for texture. The monochromatic palette creates strong contrasts between light and dark areas.
